preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each element ai in the sequence a must be between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for ai, pi in zip(a, return_value[1]) if ai != pi) == return_value[0]
postconditions.description: The number of changes made to the sequence a to produce the valid sequence return_value[1] must be equal to return_value[0].

postconditions.expression: any(pi == i for i, pi in enumerate(return_value[1], start=1))
postconditions.description: There must be exactly one index r such that pr = r, indicating the root of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in return_value[1])
postconditions.description: Each element pi in the valid sequence return_value[1] must be between 1 and n inclusive.
The valid sequence return_value[1] must contain exactly n distinct elements.
